tooltip.bottledmobs.empty: Empty: right-click a creature to capture it
tooltip.bottledmobs.usage.1: Right-click or left-click a creature to capture it
tooltip.bottledmobs.usage.2: Right-click the ground to release; sneak to place the jar
tooltip.bottledmobs.usage.3: Placed jar: use any block to replace the shell
tooltip.bottledmobs.usage.4: Sword removes the shell; stick gives a full-size figure
tooltip.bottledmobs.usage.5: Hoe/axe resize the mob; pickaxe/shovel adjust its height
tooltip.bottledmobs.usage.6: Book and quill copies settings; a written book pastes them
message.bottledmobs.cannot_capture_ridin: Cannot capture a creature that is riding or carrying passengers
